candidates.title: GoShuin: Goshuin Map & Journal for iPhone
candidates.why: Calm, warm companion: paged-book landing, paper #f8f3e7 under slate ink #2d3435 with a bronze #756449 rule accent; motion 1 with a pause control; airy space keeps focus on the staff.
candidates.leave: Pixel-dithered Japanese pattern art; underlined text links in place of buttons.

candidates.title: 一卦
candidates.why: Single-purpose tool: one central object, a serif sentence, one black pill and hairline rules on warm paper #f3f0e8; maps directly onto a staff-plus-keyboard exercise screen.
candidates.leave: Soft radial glow behind the symbol; motion level 2 is above budget 1, keep transitions subtle.

candidates.title: Stash
candidates.why: Only candidate covering chips, card-system and buttons; balanced tool density; ruled horizontal cards and compact meta tags fit the progress card and right/wrong chips.
candidates.leave: Giant slab wordmark, brutalist edge, #ffff00 yellow, grey #8a8a8a deks below 4.5:1.

candidates.title: ALMADA LABEL
candidates.why: Plain grotesk UI with one italic serif accent that could carry the encouraging voice; ink-filled square primary button; balanced, motion 1.
candidates.leave: Fashion photography and spaced wordmark; Shopify font aliases, use open alternatives only.

candidates.title: Estudio Niksen
candidates.why: Disciplined single-grotesk system, 16/24 body and 42px headings, 2px radii; a clean base for short explainer pages; motion 1.
candidates.leave: Newsletter popover over the hero; arrow on the sign-up link; strict monochrome needs warmth.

combinations.label: A
combinations.character: Warm paper-and-slate book feel: calm, grown-up, kind enough for kids.

combinations.label: B
combinations.character: Serif-led warm-paper tool with ruled cards and status chips; covers every must-have.

combinations.label: C
combinations.character: Editorial structure in warm paper with one black pill; the staff is the only focal point.
